steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step phrase on steps 1-4 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) through a MIDI device on OUT 1, in C major, with the internal clock at 90 BPM and Rate /1. In PARAMS > MOSAIC, UI motion starts Off; later steps turn it On and then change the tempo. This lesson compares the norns screen with UI motion Off and On: Off keeps everything still, On animates the small title pictures and any text too long for its space.

steps.caption: Press K2 on a Trig params slot to open its parameter list and select Quantised Fixed Note. The long name is cut short and does not scroll; its value reads CURRENT and nothing else on the screen moves.
